headline: GOLD UP 1.4%, SILVER SURGES 3%: Iran Deal Hopes Sink Oil, Lift Precious Metals on Memorial Day
snippet: Gold climbed to $4,554/oz and silver surged 3% to $77.81 on Monday as peace-deal optimism over the Strait of Hormuz dragged oil toward two-week lows. U.S. markets were closed for Memorial Day, with gold recovering from a slide to $4,500 that had put it on pace for a second consecutive weekly loss.

headline: 39.5 g/t AU-EQ OVER 3m: Cygnus Metals Completes Golden Eye Infill, MRE Upgrade Imminent
snippet: Cygnus Metals (TSX-V: CYG) completed its winter infill drill program at Golden Eye in Quebec, returning standout grades up to 39.5 g/t AuEq (35.0 g/t Au, 3.1% Cu, 30.6 g/t Ag) over 3m and 5.9m at 28.8 g/t AuEq. All 15 holes are received ahead of an imminent resource estimate upgrade at Chibougamau — the only base-metal processor within 250km of multiple advanced projects.

headline: SIXTH STRAIGHT SILVER DEFICIT: 215Moz Shortfall Is Largest on Record — Will Prices Finally Break Out?
snippet: The Silver Institute projects the largest-ever annual silver deficit in 2026 at 215 million ounces — the sixth consecutive year of shortfall — but analysts warn investors to expect violent price swings rather than a smooth climb. J.P. Morgan targets $81/oz average for the year; Citigroup sees $110 possible in H2 2026 as cumulative deficit draws since 2021 approach 762 million ounces.

headline: BEST HOLE EVER: GR Silver Drills 45.1m at 1,623 g/t Ag at San Marcial — Includes 8.25m at 8,579 g/t
snippet: GR Silver Mining (TSX-V: GRSL) announced what the company called its best-ever drill hole at Mexico's San Marcial silver deposit: SMS26-04 intercepted 45.1 metres at 1,623 g/t Ag, including 8.25 metres at 8,579 g/t — more than 8 kg silver per tonne over 8 metres. The SE Area is emerging as a high-grade zone within GR's ongoing 20,000m step-out drill campaign.

headline: ATHABASCA URANIUM DRILL SEASON OPENS: Skyharbour-Denison RL Joint Venture Breaks Ground on 4,000m+ Campaign
snippet: Skyharbour Resources (TSX-V: SYH) and funding-partner Denison Mines have commenced drilling at the RL uranium project in Saskatchewan's eastern Athabasca Basin, targeting the South Russell and Kowalchuk zones with 4,000–5,000m. The RL program is part of a broader +30,000m multi-project portfolio campaign supported by a recent C$5.25M private placement.

headline: LITHIUM MINE RESTARTS: Core Lithium (ASX: CXO) Back Mining at Finniss After A$290M Funding Package
snippet: Australia's Core Lithium (ASX: CXO) restarted mining at its Finniss operation in the Northern Territory after assembling A$290 million in funding from a Glencore Australia convertible note, Nebari debt, and a A$120M equity raise. First spodumene concentrate shipments from newly mined ore are targeted for Q3–Q4 2026, signalling a sector-wide response to recovering lithium prices.

headline: CHILE RAISES COPPER FORECAST to $5.55/lb — But Spot at $6.43 Has Already Left the Forecasters Behind
snippet: Chile's state copper commission Cochilco raised its 2026 average price forecast to $5.55/lb citing firm global demand and tight supply, up from its prior estimate — yet spot copper at $6.43/lb has already surpassed it, up 33.9% year-over-year. Cochilco expects prices to moderate to $5.10/lb in 2027 as supply disruptions at Grasberg and Candelaria ease.

headline: FINAL 109% TARIFF ON RUSSIAN PALLADIUM: U.S. Commerce Department Locks In Historic Countervailing Duty
snippet: The U.S. Department of Commerce issued a final 109.1% countervailing duty on unwrought palladium from Russia, with a separate 132.83% anti-dumping rate already in place from April. The duties become effective if the International Trade Commission confirms harm to U.S. industry — a determination that would effectively shut Russian palladium out of the world's largest palladium market.

headline: $35M GREENLAND RARE EARTH DEAL: Greenland Mines (GRML) Acquires Sarfartoq Carbonatite from Neo Performance
snippet: Greenland Mines Ltd. (Nasdaq: GRML) acquired the Sarfartoq carbonatite complex in southwest Greenland from Neo Performance Materials for US$35 million — a deposit rich in neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr) for permanent magnets used in EVs, wind turbines, and defense systems. Neo retained an equity stake and the right to purchase up to 60% of future concentrate production.

headline: NEWMONT-BACKED JUNIOR DELIVERS: Awalé Resources Posts First 1.71Moz Gold MRE at Odienné, Côte d'Ivoire
snippet: Awalé Resources (TSX-V: ARIC), with Newmont as a key strategic shareholder, published its initial inferred mineral resource of 1.71 million ounces AuEq (32.4 Mt at 1.64 g/t) across three deposits — BBM, Charger, and Empire — at the Odienné project in Côte d'Ivoire. A 100,000-metre drill program is now underway targeting resource growth.
